title: Why Some Connections Feel So Intense
desc: Why do some connections feel so intense, even when hardly anything is said? A calm, sourced long listen that takes fourteen popular beliefs about chemistry, attraction and friendship and holds each one up against the research: synchrony and conversational timing, love at first sight and thin slices, whether opposites attract, brains on the same wavelength, the chameleon effect, eye contact and pupils, the shaky bridge study and limerence, the truth about oxytocin and human pheromones, why our ideal-partner lists fail, attachment styles, the 36 questions, the liking gap, why connection matters for health, and what introverts need. It ends with a slow guided wind-down for sleep. Every claim comes from named studies, and the doubts are left in.
